offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family detached homes, townhomes and condominiums to homebuyers under the Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes names. Also originates mortgage loans for its homebuyers through a mortgage banking subsidiary. Homes are built on lots acquired mostly through option contracts, with construction done by subcontractors.

primary_products.value: single-family detached homes; townhomes; condominium homes

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual homebuyers, including first-time and move-up buyers

end_markets.value: residential housing; new home construction; mortgage finance

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of newly built homes to buyers; commissions or management fees: mortgage origination fees and gains on sale of loans to investors; service fees: title and settlement services
revenue_model.category: product sales; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes on acquired lots using subcontracted labor and purchased materials, sold to homebuyers; financial intermediary: originates mortgage loans for buyers and sells them to investors

geography_served.value: US national: Mid-Atlantic, North East, Mid East, South East and Southwest metropolitan areas across many eastern and some western states

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding with supporting mortgage banking and title services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales staff at model homes in its communities; own locations: model homes and sales centers in communities; online: website lead generation and home browsing

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, zoning and land use, environmental rules, mortgage lending regulated by CFPB, HUD and state regulators
